title: A Jet Glided 17 Minutes After Both Engines Died

scenes.text: A jet ran out of fuel at forty-one thousand feet.
In 1983, an Air Canada Boeing 767 lost both engines over Canada.
A mix-up between pounds and kilograms left it with less than half the fuel it needed.
Sixty-nine people were on board, and the pilots had no engines.
They glided for seventeen minutes and landed on an old air force runway.
The nose gear collapsed, but nobody died.

description:
In 1983 an Air Canada 767 ran out of fuel at 41,000 feet after a pounds-and-kilograms mix-up.
The pilots glided for 17 minutes and landed with all 69 people alive.
Would you have stayed calm?
thumbnail_text: A JET GLIDED WITH NO ENGINES
